defaultStatus: The operator accepted clean snake_case bootstrap keys and target REST 20017 / P2P TCP 20019 / UDP 20020 on 2026-11-12; other proposed leaf defaults still require parent review and implementation qualification.
naming: TOML, Rust and SQL names use snake_case; JSON uses camelCase and URL segments kebab-case. Use canonical names directly. No aliases, compatibility shims, fallback keys, remapping or silent ignoring; obsolete shapes are hard errors.

commonContract.productStorage: five closed typed domain documents in one SQLite database
commonContract.snapshotRead: complete domains plus one revision from one DB snapshot
commonContract.validation: closed typed whole-candidate validation; all JSON integers within exact interoperable range; no coercion
commonContract.secretHandling: credentials and generated private keys excluded from settings/status DTOs, error values, public examples and normal structured logs; once-only fresh-key provisioning is an explicit bootstrap handoff
commonContract.privateDiagnosticContract: #280 owns authenticated raw full-fidelity private export including its exact API key/sensitive-value fields and warning/acknowledgement; settings-resource exclusion assigns no export redaction or logger rewrite
commonContract.representationValidator: strong quoted settings-<saved-revision>-<64-lowercase-hex-SHA256>; digest of exact RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 identity-encoded full SettingsRead; no generated timestamp
commonContract.conditionalWrite: compare full current validator under the publication/order boundary before a write or no-op, then saved-revision CAS in the SQLite transaction; changed effective/application data can cause 412 with the same saved revision
commonContract.null: only nullable leaves clear their override
commonContract.reset: PATCH an explicit inventory default; no magic reset token
commonContract.arrays: replace the complete bounded leaf array
commonContract.application: live fields publish as one logical runtime snapshot after commit; restart fields remain pending until restart

crossValidation: network.p2p.bindIp must belong to network.p2p.bindInterface when both are non-null; automatic selection must be unambiguous.
All cross-field constraints must hold in both the saved candidate and projected effective snapshot before commit; a live cap cannot invalidate an effective restart-bound prerequisite.
network.hostnameLookup.enabled requires at least one valid DNS server; disabling lookup permits an empty resolver list.
network.nat.renewMarginSeconds must be less than network.nat.leaseDurationSeconds.
network.nat derives its local binding and mapping ports from network.p2p; there is no second mutable binding or public UDP port.
security.vpnGuard.mode=block requires a confirmed explicit local interface/address; a configured allowlist additionally gates observed public egress.
Numeric zero is allowed only where the field declares its meaning; it never means reset.
Path validation never writes or creates a target directory before settings commit; later operational errors are reported separately.
Settings documents contain no collection entities, generated identity, protocol implementation constants or bootstrap secrets.
